event: Islamabad US-Iran talks end without deal after ~21h marathon
summary: US delegation led by VP JD Vance (with Witkoff, Kushner) and Iran team led by parliamentary speaker Ghalibaf (with FM Araghchi) fail to agree on nuclear program, Hormuz status, sanctions relief. Pakistan mediated.

event: Trump announces naval blockade of Iran effective Monday
summary: After Islamabad talks collapse, Trump says US will blockade ships entering/exiting Iranian ports starting Apr 13, 10:00 AM ET. Demands Iran end nuclear program.

event: Trump Truth Social: blockade begins 10:00 AM ET Apr 13
summary: Formal blockade announcement on Truth Social: 'The United States to Blockade Ships Entering or Exiting Iranian Ports on April 13 at 10:00 A.M. ET.'

event: US naval blockade of Iranian ports formally begins (10:00 AM ET)
summary: CENTCOM: blockade covers entire Iranian coastline. 10,000+ personnel, dozen+ warships, dozens of aircraft. Trump warns Iranian vessels 'will be immediately eliminated' if they come close.

event: Trump Truth Social: Iran Navy 'at bottom of sea', 158 ships obliterated
summary: Trump claims Iranian navy destroyed; only remaining threat is 'fast attack' small boats.

event: Oil prices surge ~8%, Brent near $100, physical crude to $148.87
summary: After Islamabad talks fail and blockade announced: Brent trading $103.72, physical crude spiked to record $148.87, WTI briefly above Brent in rare inversion.

event: Pentagon: no ships made it past US blockade in first 24h
summary: Pentagon reports blockade fully implemented, halted most Iranian economic activity in ~36 hours per CENTCOM head. 'Few ships pass Strait of Hormuz since US blockade.'

event: Trump hints US-Iran talks could resume within two days
summary: Trump suggests new round of peace talks possible; Pakistan pushing to restart mediation.

event: Iran warns US naval blockade threatens ceasefire
summary: IRGC Khatam al-Anbiya commander Maj Gen Ali Abdollahi: continued blockade = violation of ceasefire. Parliament deputy speaker Nikzad: Hormuz is sovereign/legal matter.

event: Trump Truth Social posts US Navy blockade warning video
summary: Posts video: 'US announces formal blockade of Iranian ports... Vessels will be boarded for interdiction and seizure... If you do not comply... we will use force.'

event: CNN/Pentagon: US blockade 'completely halts Iran shipping' — 13 ships turned back
summary: CNN and Pentagon briefing frame blockade as working: 13 ships chose to turn around, no boarding yet required. 'Finely tuned machine.'

event: Pentagon: blockade near Hormuz deterred 13 ships
summary: CNBC/Pentagon daily: enforcement on day 4. No ships have tried to run blockade; ship traffic to Iran effectively zeroed.

event: Israel-Lebanon 10-day ceasefire agreed (effective 17:00 EST / 21:00 UTC Apr 16)
summary: US-brokered 10-day Israel-Lebanon cessation of hostilities starts. Hezbollah not a formal signatory but gave conditional acceptance.

event: Iran FM Araghchi: Strait of Hormuz 'completely open' during Lebanon truce
summary: Iran reopens Hormuz to commercial shipping, tied to Lebanon ceasefire period. Dozen+ commercial ships pass through.

event: Trump Truth Social: blockade 'WILL REMAIN IN FULL FORCE AND EFFECT'
summary: Trump: 'THE NAVAL BLOCKADE WILL REMAIN IN FULL FORCE AND EFFECT AS IT PERTAINS TO IRAN, ONLY, UNTIL SUCH TIME AS OUR TRANSACTION WITH IRAN IS 100% COMPLETE.' (timestamp from NBC/CBC — Apr 17 21:27 ET = Apr 18 01:27 UTC)

event: Iran reverses: closes Strait of Hormuz again, fires on ships
summary: Iran reimposes control of Hormuz citing 'repeated breaches of trust' by US (continued blockade). Iranian military says waterway 'returned to previous state'.

event: IRGC gunboats fire on 2 Indian-flagged ships in Hormuz (incl. VLCC Sanmar Herald)
summary: Revolutionary Guards fire on two Indian-flagged ships (one VLCC ~2M bbl Iraqi oil). Also container vessel hit by unknown projectile. UKMTO confirms. India summons Iran's ambassador.

event: Iran: studying fresh US proposals but calls blockade 'violation of ceasefire'
summary: Iran FM says studying new US proposals but characterizes naval blockade as breach of ceasefire and international law.

event: US Navy (USS Spruance) disables and seizes Iranian cargo ship Touska
summary: After 6-hour standoff, USS Spruance fires rounds into Touska's engine room to disable, then Marines rappel aboard and seize the ~900-ft Iranian-flagged cargo ship attempting to breach blockade.

event: Trump Truth Social: announces Touska seizure
summary: Trump announces Touska seizure: 'Iranian-flagged cargo ship named TOUSKA, nearly 900 feet long... tried to get past our Naval Blockade.'

event: Iran vows retaliation over 'maritime piracy' / Khatam al-Anbiya statement
summary: Khatam al-Anbiya spokesperson: 'armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran will soon respond and retaliate against this armed piracy.' Iran accuses US of violating ceasefire.

event: Iran rebuffs second round of Pakistan talks; Vance still traveling
summary: Iran says it won't attend second round of talks citing 'childish' US demands, constant shifts, and blockade. VP Vance still expected in Islamabad Monday Apr 20.

event: Pakistan ready for multi-day US-Iran talks but Tehran unsure on joining
summary: Pakistan preparing to host multi-day talks; Iran has not confirmed attendance. Ceasefire expires Wed Apr 22.
